title: Book One · Chapter 83: Not in the Middle
story:
On the next test day, the flat wooden boat is dry.

Ronan touches the joined pieces gently. Nothing moves. Mei puts the drawing beside the basin. There are three empty boxes below it, one for each stone.

Leo comes over to watch. His own group is waiting for more string. He stands back so he does not block the light.

“Empty first,” Ronan says.

The little boat floats with a narrow line of water between its long pieces. Through the clear basin, Ronan can see the cloth below.

Mei writes a zero in the first space. They made another box for no stones.

Then they place one stone in the middle. The boat sits lower. It does not tip.

“Two,” Leo whispers.

“Wait,” Ronan whispers back.

Mei makes her mark. This time he remembered to wait. Mei has time to write. Ronan smiles.

The second stone goes close to the first. The boat still floats. They put the third beside it. Water comes level with the top, but no stone falls off.

Leo looks impressed. Ronan lets himself grin.

“Now put them at the end,” Leo says.

“That is not on our page.”

“It could be.”

Mei looks at the bottom of the sheet. There is room under the boxes. She draws another small boat.

They take all three stones off. Then Ronan puts one near the front. The flat boat leans. With two there, the front goes under and both stones slide into the basin.

Ronan reaches forward, then stops himself. Miss Wu left a little cup to fetch stones with. Ronan uses it now. His sleeve stays dry.

“That one did worse,” Leo says.

“It is the same boat,” Mei tells him.

Ronan looks at it. The wood is the same. Only the stones are in a new place.

He wants to write, “Our boat can carry three.” But the stones need to be in the middle. He needs to add their place on the boat.

Mei holds the pencil out. “What shall I put?”

Ronan says it slowly. “Three stones. Close together. In the middle.”

She writes the words. Leo adds, “Not on the nose.”

“That can go underneath,” Ronan says.

Miss Wu comes to see the two pictures. “Which picture will you show the class?” she asks. Ronan chooses both.

“Then tell them about both tests,” she says.

He practises once, but his words come out too fast. He tries again. Mei points at each picture as he speaks. This time Leo does not make a joke.

At the front of the class, Ronan holds the page in both hands. He forgets the word middle. Mei points between the drawn pieces. He finds the word again.

The next group shows a narrow boat. It turns when they blow across the basin. Ronan wants to blow across his own boat too. Miss Wu tells him to make a note for later. Today they are testing boats with stones. He writes BLOW beside a small empty square. He can blow across the water another day. Today he will explain the stone test. Mei draws a little face beside the word. The face is blowing air.

“Can it carry five stones?” a child asks. Ronan looks at Miss Wu, then back at the child.

“We have only tried three.”

They did not test five stones. They tested only three. Ronan gives only that result, like the page.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- in the middle＝在中间
- level with＝与……齐平
- slide into＝滑入
- have only tried three＝只试过三颗

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：zero＝零；basin＝盆；underneath＝写在下方。

## 读句提示

**Can it carry five stones?**

它能／装下／五颗石头吗？it指刚展示的那只木片船。

## 理解问题

1. 同一只船为什么出现不同结果？
2. 有人问五颗石头行不行时，Ronan怎样回答？
